about_the_game:
----- Game Features -----

  • Over a hundred adorable capybaras

  • 24 unique levels

  • Immersive puzzle experience

  • Relaxing background music

----- Controls -----

  • Left-click to pick up and move puzzle pieces, click again to place them

  • Right-click to rotate puzzle pieces

  • Press "R" to rotate the currently held piece

  • Press "Q" to show or hide the game UI
